faqs.question: How do I get my PDF after I pay?
faqs.answer: The PDF is available to download as soon as your payment clears. There is nothing shipped.

faqs.question: Can I print the PDF more than once?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can print the file at home as many times as you need.

faqs.question: What if the PDF is not what I expected?
faqs.answer: SecretPDF offers a 30-day refund. See https://secretpdf.co/refund-policy for the details.

faqs.question: How do I contact SecretPDF?
faqs.answer: Email support@secretpdf.co with your question or order details.
